They learn all about how to mix colors to make a beautiful rainbow painting, shrink down to dance with Bendjamin the Klutz and ride a library cart on a hunt for books about dinosaurs!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Get ready for magical mayhem and manic missions with Joey and Boo! The chaos begins when they concoct a witch's brew that's too potent and transforms Boo into a giant four-eyed creature! Then, they find a magical phone on the ground and start taking selfies and playing music, but things quickly get out of hand. The magical mayhem continues when a pot of ink changes their color, turning them into fugitives on the run from the bug police!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Joey and Boo are a pair of losers when their search for food goes wrong. They battle a fly for a pear, get stuck in jelly and ride an out-of-control meatball. They also get trapped inside a worm, get stuck in earwax and deal with a leaky tap. No matter what they do, their simple tasks turn into wild, chaotic adventures.

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: Join the Park Rangers for a super silly day of ranger fails! First, Park Ranger Darren accidentally gets his night vision goggles stuck on his head, leaving him unable to see properly. Park Ranger Asher has to step up to be Darren's eyes and ears to guide him! Then, in another silly mishap, Darren accidentally gets hit with a sleepy dart! Can Park Rangers Asher and Naomi find the ingredients for the Wake Up Juice in time?

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: Join the Park Rangers for a super fun day of pranks and rescues! While exploring the ranch, Rangers Tara and Asher stumble upon a series of pranks, including trick eggs bursting with silly spray! But who could be the prankster? Then, it's new Park Ranger Naomi's first day at the ranch! But things go awry when a pterodactyl swoops in and flies away with her important work. Can she find a way to get it back?

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch

The two rangers must team up to get it back. Then, the rangers must race against time to find more food for the dinosaurs after Darren accidentally burns their dinner. The day ends with another rescue, as the kids must save Darren when some raptors start chasing him while he's learning to ride a bike!

Back at the clubhouse, Blippi learns how to interpret a puppy's tail wags and even travels back in time again to help a real-life knight in shining armor-who happens to be a corgi!

Finally, Jeff gets his fortune read by a mysterious teller, but when he refuses to pay, she places a curse on him!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are having a summer of fun, learning and camping! Newt discovers that Fuse can't ride a bike because of a childhood trauma, so she kindly offers to teach him. Then, on a sweltering day, Fuse and Zee get into a bickering match over who is last in line for the ice cream van. Finally, Fuse goes camping for some alone time, but his trip is ruined by the arrival of Jeff and all his modern camping conveniences!

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: The team's experiment with a growth potion backfires, turning into a body-swap formula that lands Zak in Gramps's body right before he's kidnapped by Adilla! As the others race to create an antidote, they must also attend the Fly's Festival of Light. Their day goes from bad to worse when they discover the guest of honor, Willow, is actually intended to be the festival's sacrifice, forcing them to stage a daring fake ritual to save her.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: The Insectibles are in double trouble! First, when Adilla captures the team, Zak must go on a lone mission to save them. He finds a wise Praying Mantis who teaches him the art of kung-fu so he can confront the roaches and free his friends! Meanwhile, Willow, Chowser and Syd find themselves stuck to a powerful bar magnet trap set by Adilla in her tower. It's up to Gramps' clever tinkering to cause some unexpected magnetic mayhem and help them escape!

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: The Insectibles are split into two desperate missions! After a trek through a strange mushroom patch turns most of the gang into mindless zombies, Zak and Willow must form a reluctant alliance with Adilla to find a cure. At the same time, Chowser, lured by a chunk of cheese, falls into a trap and is taken captive by Fred. The remaining team members must now race to save their friend from Fred's secret tunnel while also dealing with the zombie plague.

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Join the Antiks on a series of chaotic adventures for delicious food! Whether it's a tantalizing lollipop, a rolling olive, or a crumb from a biscuit, Joey and Boo will do whatever it takes to get it. Their journey is filled with unexpected obstacles, from treacherous sticky tape to menacing fly swatters and even a mind-controlling mushroom. Through teamwork and clever thinking, these tiny heroes face every challenge head-on in a comical pursuit of their next meal.

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Spring has sprung, and so have the Antiks! Join them as they explore a world of blossoming flowers and fresh spring treats. From climbing giant mushrooms to navigating through a garden of delights, their adventures are as colorful as the season. It's a story about discovery, teamwork, and enjoying the sweet tastes of spring.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Neither snow nor rain can stop the mail! Blippi is learning all about the journey a letter takes. He visits a post office to see how mail is sorted and then learns about the important job of a mail carrier. It's a special delivery of fun and facts about the postal service.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi for a day of prehistoric and geological wonders! The adventure starts with a visit to the active Kilauea volcano in Hawaii where Blippi explores plant and animal life around a crater with a local tour guide. Then he travels back in time at the Orlando Science Center where he learns about fossils, growls like a dinosaur and meets a giant T-Rex and a Triceratops with three enormous horns.

programme.title: 3 Nota
programme.desc: Kopak, bekas banduan, berdepan prejudis masyarakat selepas bebas dari penjara. programme.title: New York Cinta

programme.title: Mawar Putih Tanda Perpisahan

programme.title: Little Baby Bum
programme.desc: Go from bathtime to bedtime with Mia and Max! The fun starts with a splashy, bubbly good time as the kids play with their rubber ducks and get nice and clean in the tub. programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle

The fun continues as Twinkle shares a box full of super fun toys, and her friends learn how to play new musical instruments!

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle

programme.title: Digley & Dazey

Sing along with Tucker the Turtle as he takes a bath and watch as Baby Grub eagerly learns the importance of dental care by brushing her big, sharp shark teeth!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: The Sharksons are using their brains for some clever underwater fixes! Then, when Grub can't get to sleep because she's afraid of the dark, Stanley has a clever idea to make a 'star' night light from a glove that floated down. From turning veggies into a fun game to sorting recycling, there's always a clever fix!

Then it's time to learn numbers by singing along and counting the five cute penguins and five little ducks! The learning continues with a fun animal bus ride, a trip to space to sing 'Hey Diddle Diddle' and an important lesson on how to cross the road carefully with a mother cat and her kitten.

programme.title: KiiYii

From learning colors to singing a soothing lullaby, these songs will make you feel good!
